value.rationale: A sharp qualitative robustness threshold for newly introduced FJR+: two-seat committees preserve proportionality under winner-approval expansions but three-seat committees can lose it. The minimal (n,m)=(4,5) witness directly improves the originating paper’s (6,7) witness at four seats and clarifies where FJR+ departs from EJR+ monotonicity. The finite cutoff is motivated by real committee-size behavior and is not an arbitrary numerical slice.
